question: At present, Amar is 5 years younger than Ravi. After four years from now, Ravi will be twice as old as Amar. Find Amar’s present age (in years).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Amar = A ⇒ Ravi = A + 5

After 4 years: Ravi = A + 9, Amar = A + 4

Condition: A + 9 = 2(A + 4)

⇒ A + 9 = 2A + 8 ⇒ A = 1

**∴ Answer = 1 year**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amar is 5 years younger than Ravi, and after 4 years Ravi will be twice Amar

**Formula used:**

Age relation forms linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present age of Amar = x

⇒ Then Ravi = x + 5

⇒ After 4 years, Amar = x + 4

⇒ After 4 years, Ravi = x + 5 + 4 = x + 9

⇒ Given: Ravi = 2 × Amar

⇒ x + 9 = 2(x + 4)

⇒ x + 9 = 2x + 8

⇒ 9 − 8 = 2x − x

⇒ x = 1

⇒ Amar’s present age = 1 year

**∴ The correct answer is 1 year.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Age difference between two persons always remains constant

Linear Equation

Age problems can be solved by forming linear equations

Future Age Concept

After n years, add n to present age

Shortcut Insight

Translate directly into equation instead of long steps
